messages.subject: Error: isTRUE(gpclibPermitStatus()) is not TRUE
parts:
I'm getting this error:
Error: isTRUE(gpclibPermitStatus()) is not TRUE

After I run the following code that I found to plot maps from Rdata
from gadm. Any help? The code is being given after I use the fortify
function.

require(ggplot2)
library(sp)
load(url("http://gadm.org/data/rda/CHE_adm1.RData"))
head(as.data.frame(gadm))
ch <- fortify(gadm, region = "ID_1")
str(ch)
qplot(long, lat, group = group, data = ch,
geom = "polygon", colour = I("white"))


Thanks
